final: WITH tavg AS (SELECT t.telescregistry AS tid, t.equipstatus AS st, AVG(s.pulsepersec) AS a FROM signals s JOIN telescopes t ON s.telescref = t.telescregistry GROUP BY t.telescregistry, t.equipstatus), savg AS (SELECT st, AVG(a) AS a FROM tavg WHERE a IS NOT NULL GROUP BY st), m1 AS (SELECT AVG(a) AS m FROM savg), k1 AS (SELECT savg.st, savg.a FROM savg, m1 WHERE savg.a > m1.m), m2 AS (SELECT AVG(a) AS m FROM k1), k2 AS (SELECT k1.st, k1.a FROM k1, m2 WHERE k1.a > m2.m) SELECT AVG(k2.a) AS avg_of_remaining, AVG(k2.a - (SELECT m FROM m1)) AS avg_excess_over_first_mean, AVG(k2.a - (SELECT m FROM m2)) AS avg_excess_over_second_mean FROM k2
